evidence_kind: supplied synthetic packaged-artifact and loader contract; no executable launch
requirement: Only the original authorized application JavaScript may execute. Reject altered archives and do not select attacker-created application directories.
attacker: May replace resources/app.asar and create resources/app; cannot change the trusted signed executable, its embedded digest, or effective fuse settings.
effective_loader_contract: OnlyLoadAppFromAsar=true selects only resources/app.asar. Otherwise resources/app is selected first when present. EnableEmbeddedAsarIntegrityValidation=true rejects an ASAR whose digest differs from immutable binary metadata before running any of its JavaScript. That check covers ASAR only, not a selected directory. No additional ACL, signature or recovery loader blocks these paths.
